# `edit.delete`

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs-gen` from crates/ew-commands/schemas/edit.delete.schema.json. Do not edit: change the source and regenerate. -->

`edit.delete`: removes the selected records with everything the delete policies take along
(FR-DEV-030), in **one** delete plan for all targets (`TxBuilder::delete_many`): the result does not
depend on the order of the targets, a target that another target's cascade removes is planned once,
and a target listed twice counts once. Deleting a representation leaves its function unplaced (an IP
function goes with it); deleting a device removes its functions, their representations and
connections. A target that does not exist at the start is `NotFound`; a forbid link (a strip with
terminals, a referenced structure node) rejects the whole command (`ModelError::Referenced`). Cost:
`Bulk` when the plan removes or changes more than 500 records (D4; the plan is computed once by
`cost`). A released or withdrawn revision is immutable (FR-REV-009): naming one is refused at
`/targets/<i>`; the open revision may be deleted. Outcome: none.

### CmdUuid

A lower-case hyphenated UUID naming a record (doc 05 §3.2).

Type: string (at least 36 character(s), at most 36 character(s))

Pattern: `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`

## Exit codes

A command runs as one line of a command log replayed by `ew apply` ([doc 17 §3.5](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#35-command-logs-ewcmd)). The exit code of `ew apply` is:

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | The line committed as one transaction. |
| 1 | A prevent rule or the command's own domain rule refused the line (`Prevented`, `Rejected`); without `--one-step` the lines before it stay committed and are saved, with `--one-step` nothing is saved. |
| 2 | Anything else stops the replay: invalid parameters, a missing record, an unresolvable reference, an open, lock or save error. |

The codes of every subcommand are in [doc 17 §3.2](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/docs/design/17-extensibility.md#32-exit-codes).
